title: Two-week campaign
when: You are launching something: a product, a course, a service, a video series, an application round.
summary: One offer, one audience, one call to action. Teaser, proof, objections, offer, last call.

steps.title: Define the offer
steps.do: What, for whom, the single call to action, the real deadline, and the proof you can show.

steps.title: Map the objections
steps.do: List why someone would not act. Each objection becomes a piece of content.

steps.title: Plan the arc
steps.do: Teaser, proof, objection answers, offer, last call. Spread across the platforms you use.

steps.title: Produce the assets
steps.do: Hooks, scripts, carousels and text posts for each beat of the arc.

steps.title: Check claims and disclosure
steps.do: No invented results or testimonials. Disclose any material connection.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.do: Answer every question. DM warm replies with something useful, not a pitch.

steps.title: Debrief
steps.do: What moved people to act? Log it for next time.
